variants.specifics: Brackenford: Wenna, the miller's widow, wants the Amulet of Plenty back from the Urchins of the old barrow, and her hired man Tobin, who went after it.

offer.speaker: Wenna
offer.text:
While the rest of Brackenford frets over Red Corwin, there's a smaller job which I need done.

Tobin, my hired man, chased the Urchins who broke into the mill last night and took the Amulet of Plenty.

Those Urchins have burrowed into the old barrow east of the ford. Tobin went in after them. He hasn't come out.

Will you bring the Amulet back to me and find out what became of Tobin?

refusal.speaker: Wenna
refusal.text: Fine then, leave my amulet with those thieving Urchins!

reminder.speaker: Wenna
reminder.text: Off to that barrow with you! Hurry!

completion.speaker: Wenna
completion.text:
You found the Amulet of Plenty! Wonderful!

My worst fears for Tobin, however, have come to pass. I'll miss the old goat, but we have no time for weeping. Reeve Halvard needs help with Red Corwin and has been asking for you.

Take this, with my thanks!

after.speaker: Wenna
after.text: Thanks again for bringing back my amulet, lad.

journal.text: Recover the Amulet of Plenty the Urchins stole from Wenna's mill.

journal_done.text: COMPLETED: Recover the Amulet of Plenty the Urchins stole from Wenna's mill.

variants.specifics: Dolgar: Widow Orla's magic lantern was carried off by the Imps to their nest under the old smelter.

offer.speaker: Orla
offer.text:
Oh, please help, kind stranger! The Imps have raided my kitchen and run off with my magic lantern, down into their nest under the old smelter!

Will you bring it back? I'd owe you everything!

refusal.speaker: Orla
refusal.text: Oh dear! Then I'll just sit here in the dark!

reminder.speaker: Orla
reminder.text: Anything else you find in that nest is yours! Just hurry and fetch my lantern!

completion.speaker: Orla
completion.text:
Oh, bless you, you found it! What could I ever give you for such courage?!

What's that? Heaps and heaps of gold? Well, if gold is what you're after, please accept this as a token of my appreciation.

journal.text: Fetch Orla's magic lantern from the Imps' nest in Dolgar.

journal_done.text: COMPLETED: Fetch Orla's magic lantern from the Imps' nest in Dolgar.

variants.writer: Claude Agent SDK subagent, Claude Opus 5.5

variants.specifics: Pellmire: Nella's uncle's lucky amulet was snatched by the Urchins, who ran to the net sheds.

offer.speaker: Nella
offer.text:
Those Urchins just made off with my uncle's lucky amulet! If it isn't found, he'll be ruined. He's coming home from market tonight!

Oh please, help me, kind stranger! I think the Urchins that grabbed it ran to the net sheds.

Will you... could you find it for me?

refusal.speaker: Nella
refusal.text: Oh.... Then I suppose I'll look for it myself.

reminder.speaker: Nella
reminder.text: Oh, hurry! Uncle's boat could come in any time now!

completion.speaker: Nella
completion.text: Oh, thank you, thank you! Please take this as a token of my appreciation!

after.speaker: Nella
after.text: Thanks again for all your help!

journal.text: Retrieve Nella's amulet from the Urchins at the net sheds.

journal_done.text: COMPLETED: Retrieve Nella's amulet from the Urchins at the net sheds.

variants.specifics: Korlen: Old Agna: the Urchins of the old quarry ran off with her cane.

offer.speaker: Agna
offer.text:
Aiieee! Stay away! Don't hurt me!

Eh? Only a young fellow?! I can't get up to see you properly. But you're surely no Urchin, not like those nasty little things that ran off with my cane! I can barely take a step without it.

Will you fetch it back for me? You'd save an old woman and I'd never forget it.

refusal.speaker: Agna
refusal.text: Oh.... Then I'll just sit here and wait, I suppose.

reminder.speaker: Agna
reminder.text: Have you found my cane?! Oh.... Well, the Urchins who took it hide in the old quarry east of town.

completion.speaker: Agna
completion.text: My cane! You found it! May all that is great bless you! And please, take this potion. It draws the poison out of any bite. It would be a godsend to anyone who walks the wilds.

journal.text: Retrieve old Agna's cane from the Urchins in the quarry.

journal_done.text: COMPLETED: Retrieve old Agna's cane from the Urchins in the quarry.

variants.specifics: Ondel: Ishmar the Conjurer has lost his Rain Staff to the Imps of Gull Rock and offers the player passage in his boat to Tavarin.

offer.speaker: Ishmar
offer.text:
Miserable little thieves! The Imps only flew down from the hills last month and they are already a terrible nuisance!

I am Ishmar the Conjurer. I am missing my Rain Staff. I fear the Imps have carried it off to their nest on Gull Rock.

If you could find it and return it to me, I would take you along in my boat to Tavarin. Will you do this for me?

refusal.speaker: Ishmar
refusal.text: Very well. I shall have to find someone braver.

reminder.speaker: Ishmar
reminder.text: Is there any sign of my staff? Oh my, this is most distressing.

completion.speaker: Ishmar
completion.text:
My Rain Staff! Those little devils must have fought over it.

You have shown the Imps who is master here. Perhaps you might be of further use to me. Hmmm... Very well.

Come down to my boathouse with me. Whenever you wish, just climb into the boat and I will row us across to Tavarin. There is a great deal to be done once we land.

after.speaker: Ishmar
after.text: Whenever you wish, just climb into the boat and we will push off.

journal.text: Retrieve Ishmar's Rain Staff from the Imps.

journal_done.text: COMPLETED: Retrieve Ishmar's Rain Staff from the Imps.

variants.specifics: Ostrel: Mayor Pellimore's silver staff was stolen from the Town Hall by the Imps of the old quarry.

offer.speaker: Pellimore
offer.text:
Welcome to Ostrel, brave Wanderer! Master Olvane told us you would come!

The Imps who live in the old quarry have gone wild! They crept into the Town Hall and stole my silver staff! One of the guards ran after the little thieves into the quarry, but hasn't come back.

Will you go into the quarry pits, West of town, and win back my staff from those Imps? When you come back, please find me. I will be at the Town Hall on the square.

refusal.speaker: Pellimore
refusal.text: Hmph! Well, I suppose I'll ask someone else, then.

reminder.speaker: Pellimore
reminder.text: Those pesky Imps are getting far too bold these days.

completion.speaker: Pellimore
completion.text:
My silver staff! Thank you, kind sir! Every soul in Ostrel is grateful for the great deed you have done.

Here, accept this small gift from the town. Master Olvane is waiting for you up at the College. Stock up at the shops before you go, then see him at once.

after.speaker: Pellimore
after.text: I have only my thanks left to give you. Go and find Master Olvane. He has been asking for you up at the College.

journal.text: Recover Mayor Pellimore's silver staff from the Imps.

journal_done.text: COMPLETED: Recover Mayor Pellimore's silver staff from the Imps.

variants.specifics: Fort Skarra: Vardis the Sage waits on the Silver Horn that Ebbet was forging for the fort. Ebbet's hut lies down the west slope, and Ebbet is dead.

offer.speaker: Vardis
offer.text:
Ebbet has been forging a Silver Horn for the fort for a long while. It ought to have been done and carried up the pass by now.

Take the goat path down to Ebbet's hut on the west slope and bring back the Horn. Will you go for me?

refusal.speaker: Vardis
refusal.text: Very well. But the fort cannot wait long for that Horn.

reminder.speaker: Vardis
reminder.text: Find Ebbet and bring the Horn back here -- no matter the danger! Watch your footing on the way down. Wolves prowl the slopes!

completion.speaker: Vardis
completion.text:
You've brought back the Silver Horn! Wonderful!

Poor Ebbet, however, is gone, as I feared he would be. I will grieve for him, but sadly the Undead leave us no time for it. Take this Ankh for your trouble, and Warden Ostrag has asked to see you.

Good luck, Wanderer!

after.speaker: Vardis
after.text: Thanks again for bringing back the Horn.

journal.text: Recover the Silver Horn which Ebbet has made.

journal_done.text: COMPLETED: Recover the Silver Horn which Ebbet has made.

variants.specifics: Vurn: Ambrel asks the player to bring back the Helm of Far Sight, carried off by Imps to the Cinder Caves.

offer.speaker: Ambrel
offer.text: Greetings, Wanderer! Thank the stars someone has come at last, for we badly need a strong arm. A band of Imps raided Vurn only days ago and made off with the Helm of Far Sight! Will you go to the Cinder Caves in the southwest and bring the precious relic back to me?

refusal.speaker: Ambrel
refusal.text: Alas! Then I fear the Helm is lost to us. Come back if you change your mind.

reminder.speaker: Ambrel
reminder.text: Quickly, bring back the Helm! Do not delay! For if he ever lays hands on it, Vargoth will put the Helm to the vilest of uses, indeed!

completion.speaker: Ambrel
completion.text:
Congratulations! My heartfelt thanks for bringing back the Helm! With it back in our hands, we will at last see through that wicked fire-mage's schemes!

Here, these Mana potions and this Ankh will serve you well... perhaps sooner than you'd like.

after.speaker: Ambrel
after.text: Thanks once more for everything you've done.

journal.text: Recover the Helm of Far Sight from the Imps.

journal_done.text: COMPLETED: Recover the Helm of Far Sight from the Imps.

variants.specifics: Varrow: Widow Olla's son was bitten by an Urchin when they raided the mill, and they ran off with her healing amulet.

offer.speaker: Olla
offer.text:
Hello, brave Adventurer! Oh, please help me, a dreadful fever has struck my son!

Not long ago, a pack of Urchins broke into the mill. One of the little beasts bit my boy, and now he burns with fever! I could heal him with my healing amulet, but they ran off with it to their caves east of the mill. I dare not leave his bedside, or he may get worse!

Will you get my amulet back from those thieves? I will pay a worthy reward for its safe return.

refusal.speaker: Olla
refusal.text: Very well, let those Urchins keep my amulet!

reminder.speaker: Olla
reminder.text: Why are you dawdling? My boy needs that amulet!

completion.speaker: Olla
completion.text: Oh, thank you, thank you! I can't ever repay you enough for this kindness... But please, accept this as a token of my appreciation!

journal.text: Recover Widow Olla's healing amulet from the Urchin caves.

journal_done.text: COMPLETED: Recover Widow Olla's healing amulet from the Urchin caves.

variants.specifics: Tolm: Vessa's Rain Staff was taken by an Ogre who beat her farmhands, bound for Krog Durm.

offer.speaker: Vessa
offer.text: Ooooh, how could this happen? That Ogre brute knocked down both of my farmhands. The guards will never get here in time. Please, will you catch him before he carries the Rain Staff off to Krog Durm?

refusal.speaker: Vessa
refusal.text: Oh.... Then the Rain Staff is gone for good.

reminder.speaker: Vessa
reminder.text: Please, I'm begging you. Run down that thieving Ogre and bring back the Rain Staff.

completion.speaker: Vessa
completion.text: The Rain Staff is safe! You will need my old Ankh more than I will, up at Krog Durm. Here, take it with you.

after.speaker: Vessa
after.text: You may have saved every field in Tolm with your bold deeds. Well done, young sir! Now, hurry on to Mayor Corbel.

journal.text: Recover the Rain Staff stolen from Vessa by an Ogre.

journal_done.text: COMPLETED: Recover the Rain Staff stolen from Vessa by an Ogre.
